messages:
kai: Customer reported confusing SDK errors during onboarding — backend returned error:'invalid_credentials' but SDK surfaced '400 Bad Request' only.
meera: That's the parity bug. We need to prefer body.error codes over status code mapping and attach structured metadata (code, retryable, suggestion).
jon: Proposal: layered mapping: 1) parse JSON body for a machine code field and match against a mapping table; 2) fallback to status-code heuristics; 3) include friendly_message and action_hint in the typed exception object.
kai: For auth flows, if body.code indicates auth issue (invalid_credentials, refresh_token_missing) prefer action_hint 'reauth' even if refresh attempt returns 5xx. That prevents the client from auto-retrying into a 500.
ci-bot: [ci] go-sdk tests failing: error_map_test.go: expect RefreshTokenMissingError but got BadRequestError. https://ci.redwood.internal/8888
meera: I'll own the cross-SDK mapping spec and sample-app fixtures. We'll publish a canonical mapping file (resources/error-mapping.json) with fields: code, friendly_message, retryable, action_hint.
jon: I'll update go-sdk error structs to include Code, Retryable, Suggestion and add a small HTTP middleware to build typed errors from body. Will keep Error() string to preserve backwards compatibility.
kai: Also update onboarding docs to render friendly_message and action_hint so the UI can prompt reauth or contact-support.
meera: Sample-app tests to add: expired refresh -> RefreshTokenMissingError -> show reauth; expired refresh + auth 502 -> show reauth; 503 with Retry-After -> ServerError retryable.
jon: I'll open PR today for go-sdk and land tests against the new fixtures.
kai: Owners: jon (go-sdk), meera (spec + samples), kai (onboarding copy). Mark as p1 for next sprint.
